description: Accordion extends the native HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> properties for its content region.

elements.name: open
elements.description: Controls whether the accordion is expanded. When omitted, the accordion manages its own state.

elements.name: defaultOpen
elements.description: Sets the initial expanded state for an uncontrolled accordion. Defaults to false.

elements.name: onToggleChange
elements.description: Called with the next expanded state when the accordion is toggled.

elements.name: view
elements.description: Selects the header view: none (default), icon, or card. The icon and card views provide their own toggle button.

elements.name: header
elements.description: Content displayed in the header for the icon and card views.

elements.name: variant
elements.description: Changes the accordion styling. Available values are around (default), left, and none.

elements.name: tooltip
elements.description: Enables or disables the expand/collapse tooltip on the built-in toggle. Defaults to true.

elements.name: ripple
elements.description: Enables or disables the ripple effect on the card view. It defaults to enabled for the around variant and disabled otherwise.

elements.name: text
elements.description: Customizes the accessible and tooltip labels with expand and collapse strings.

elements.name: transitionMs
elements.description: Sets the expand/collapse transition duration in milliseconds. Defaults to 300.

elements.name: containerProps
elements.description: Native HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> applied to the outer wrapper of the icon and card views.

accessibility.general: The icon and card views use a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls to expose the accordion state and relationship.
elements: Provide a meaningful header when using the icon or card view.
The content is rendered as a region and becomes inert while collapsed, preventing keyboard interaction with hidden content.
For the icon view, the built-in toggle receives an accessible expand/collapse label. Customize it with the text prop when needed.
